FINAL CANDIDATE ANSWER

The odds ratio for the p53-mediated cell cycle gene regulation term in gseapy/Reactome_2022 could not be produced because the analysis environment has no network access and no installed/cached copy of gseapy or the Reactome_2022 gene-set library — Enrichr cannot be reached and the required gene sets do not exist locally. Per the agreed condition, no number was fabricated. The complete differential-expression work (which supplies the exact input gseapy.enrichr would consume) was executed and retained.

Executed DE result (CBD+cisplatin combination, Group 9 Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50, vs DMSO, Group 3; 3 vs 3; DESeq2-style NB pipeline on raw counts): of 63,677 genes, 15,782 had baseMean>10 (tested set); 8,110 had p<0.05; 1,813 passed p<0.05 and |log2FC|>0.5 (989 up, 824 down); after ENSG→gene-symbol mapping, 1,697 unique DE symbols (output/de_gene_list.txt) — this is the intended gseapy.enrichr gene_list. Biologically, the list is consistent with p53 activation in the combination arm: CDKN1A (p21), the canonical p53 cell-cycle effector, is strongly up (log2FC=+1.20, p=5.6e-201), as is ALDH1A3 (+1.62), while glycolysis/metabolism genes (GAPDH, ENO1, ALDOA, LDHA, PGK1, SLC2A1) are down.

Environment checks actually performed, with outputs:
(1) Alternate channels: `conda`, `mamba`, `micromamba` — none exist on PATH (command -v empty). No pip mirror: `pip config list` empty, no PIP_INDEX_URL/UV_INDEX/HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY in env, no /etc/pip.conf or ~/.pip/pip.conf or ~/.config/pip/pip.conf. Wheel caches: `pip cache dir` → /tmp/cache/pip, `pip cache list` → "No locally built wheels cached"; ~/.cache absent. Filesystem search for gseapy*/pydeseq2* across /root, /home, /opt, /usr/local, /mnt: nothing; only the runner venv's site-packages exists (13 packages: pandas, numpy, scipy, statsmodels, etc.).
(2) HTTP-layer network tests: `urllib.request.urlopen('https://maayanlab.cloud/Enrichr/addList')` → URLError "[Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution"; same for https://amp.pharm.mssm.edu/Enrichr and https://pypi.org/simple/; `curl -v https://amp.pharm.mssm.edu/Enrichr` → "curl: (6) Could not resolve host". These are DNS-level failures, not proxy-bypassable (no proxy vars exist).
(3) Gene-set files: full-filesystem search (excluding /proc, /sys) for *.gmt, *Reactome*, *enrichr* → zero matches.
(4) Enrichr REST fallback (addList → enrich with Reactome_2022): not possible — there is no network path to any Enrichr host (DNS fails at the socket layer for all endpoints), so the REST flow cannot even begin.

Artifacts: de_analysis.py (executed end-to-end; contains the exact gseapy.enrichr(gene_list=…, gene_sets="Reactome_2022") call that will emit the Odds Ratio verbatim on any networked runner), output/de_results_basemean10.csv, output/de_genes_filtered_symbols.csv, output/de_gene_list.txt, output/enrichment_blocker.txt.
